overview_description.description: Visarun is a digital platform that uses artificial intelligence to assist individuals and businesses with visa and travel document processing. The platform provides tools for managing visa applications, organizing required documentation, tracking application progress, and helping users navigate country-specific travel requirements. It is designed to streamline administrative tasks related to international travel and immigration workflows for travelers, agencies, and corporate users.

about_short_description.short_description: Visarun is a AI-based platform for managing tourist and business visa applications, document verification, and visa workflow tracking.

product.name: Visarun Automated Visa Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that automates the entire visa application process from document upload to final approval, including tracking and interview preparation.

product.name: Smart Visa Route
product.description: An AI-driven feature that recommends the optimal visa application path based on user data such as destination, visa type, and approval likelihood.

product.name: Automatic Document Verification
product.description: A machine learning-based system that automatically checks uploaded visa documents for compliance and errors to ensure they meet visa requirements.

product.name: AI Assist 24/7
product.description: An AI-powered assistant providing continuous support and personalized guidance on visa requirements, document preparation, and application steps.

product.name: Visa Approval Calculator
product.description: A tool that estimates the probability of visa approval based on user data to help applicants make informed decisions before applying.

product.name: AI Consulate Interview Simulation
product.description: A virtual simulation tool that prepares applicants for consulate interviews by providing tailored practice questions and feedback.
